lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of approximately 30 high-luminance circular spots is visible, arranged in roughly six vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit. These spots maintain relatively uniform inter-node distance within the mid-lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clearly defined vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal rows of blobs, forming distinct grid-like anchor nodes across the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible running parallel to the lateral line, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal aspect and deep shadow on the ventral aspect of each ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of smaller, irregularly sized high-luminance blobs that lack the structured grid arrangement seen on the lateral flank.
